description: This file defines a static extension class for the Entity Framework DbSet of Articles, adding a method to retrieve articles with related data using eager loading.

classes.name: ArticleExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for the Article entity, specifically a method to retrieve articles with related entities eagerly loaded.

methods.name: GetAllData
methods.description: An extension method for DbSet<Article> that returns an IQueryable<Article> with related entities included, optimized for read-only scenarios.
